caption: The drawing depicts two views of the same object, which appears to be a fabric bonnet or cap. The primary object is drawn near the top center and features horizontal ridges running across its rounded surface. The front of the bonnet has a ruffled edge that frames the opening, and a wide, softly draped section extends downward, possibly representing a brim or lower section that would rest against the neck. Below this larger depiction, there is a smaller sketch of the same bonnet, shown from a different angle, revealing the ridged construction spiraling around the top and the brim flaring outwards. The drawing is executed in fine pencil or ink lines on light beige or off-white paper, with minimal shading and no use of color other than the natural color of the paper background.
title: Bonnet
